WA_PROVIDER.label: Sending provider
WA_PROVIDER.hint: «Meta direct» sends through Meta's API with the access token and app secret in this section; «Kapso» sends through Kapso with the project key in the Kapso section; «CRM» sends through the academy CRM's API with its key in the CRM section. A manual switch per line, never an automatic failover.

WA_API_BASE.label: Graph API base URL
WA_API_BASE.hint: Meta's servers, or the stub's address in development.

WA_API_VERSION.label: Graph API version
WA_API_VERSION.hint: Like v21.0. Check it before going live: Meta retires old versions.

WA_PHONE_NUMBER_ID.label: Phone number ID
WA_PHONE_NUMBER_ID.hint: The notifications line's number ID in Meta.

WA_WABA_ID.label: WhatsApp Business account ID
WA_WABA_ID.hint: The account that owns the templates and the notifications line.

WA_APP_ID.label: Meta app ID
WA_APP_ID.hint: Needed to upload samples for templates with a document header.

WA_ACCESS_TOKEN.label: Access token
WA_ACCESS_TOKEN.hint: The Meta app token the notifications line sends with.

WA_APP_SECRET.label: App secret
WA_APP_SECRET.hint: The server checks the signature of Meta's incoming calls with it.

WA_VERIFY_TOKEN.label: Webhook verify token
WA_VERIFY_TOKEN.hint: The same token set in Meta's webhook settings for both apps.

WA_CHAT_PROVIDER.label: Chat line sending provider
WA_CHAT_PROVIDER.hint: Chosen for the chat line alone; its phone and account ids in this section stay the same under either provider.

WA_CHAT_PHONE_NUMBER_ID.label: Chat line phone number ID
WA_CHAT_PHONE_NUMBER_ID.hint: Enough on its own to receive this line's messages.

WA_CHAT_WABA_ID.label: Chat line account ID
WA_CHAT_WABA_ID.hint: Needed to send from the chat line.

WA_CHAT_APP_ID.label: Chat line app ID
WA_CHAT_APP_ID.hint: Needed to submit a PDF-header template from the chat line, and shown in the line check; it never falls back to the notifications app ID.

WA_CHAT_ACCESS_TOKEN.label: Chat line access token
WA_CHAT_ACCESS_TOKEN.hint: When not set, the notifications line's token is used.

WA_CHAT_APP_SECRET.label: Chat line app secret
WA_CHAT_APP_SECRET.hint: Needed when the chat line has its own Meta app.

KAPSO_API_BASE.label: Kapso API base URL
KAPSO_API_BASE.hint: In production: https://api.kapso.ai/meta/whatsapp. Empty = no line switched to Kapso can send.

KAPSO_API_KEY.label: Kapso project API key
KAPSO_API_KEY.hint: From the project settings in Kapso. Sent as the X-API-Key header; never shown after saving.

KAPSO_WEBHOOK_SECRET.label: Kapso webhook signing secret
KAPSO_WEBHOOK_SECRET.hint: In Kapso, create a webhook of kind meta to the API origin followed by /webhooks/kapso, then paste its secret here.

WACRM_API_BASE.label: CRM API base
WACRM_API_BASE.hint: The CRM's address followed by /api/v1. Left empty, no line switched to «CRM» sends.

WACRM_API_KEY.label: CRM API key
WACRM_API_KEY.hint: From the CRM: Settings → API keys, with the messages:send scope. Sent in the Authorization header and never shown after saving.

WACRM_WEBHOOK_SECRET.label: CRM webhook signing secret
WACRM_WEBHOOK_SECRET.hint: In the CRM, add a webhook to the API origin followed by /webhooks/wacrm for the event message.status_updated, then paste its secret here so delivery ticks arrive.

WA_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS.label: Allowed recipients
WA_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS.hint: International numbers separated by commas. Leave empty for no restriction.

WA_TEMPLATE_SYNC.label: Template sync with Meta
WA_TEMPLATE_SYNC.hint: Turn it off while using Meta test credentials so the template registry does not change.
